author_controls.scope: Original dedup/common functions on temporary owned cards; no apply_manifest or legacy apply, no user vault.

confirmed_findings: merge_content ignores different body text under same section heading and distinct equal-length lists; observed changed=False. Extra source retained in control, no deletion or move tested.

Conflict merge stamps canonical updated=today after accepting February value, causing later March extra to lose against October stamp; old/losing values preserved in History. Finite ordered three-card fixture.
redirect_links rewrites fenced-code example, preserves display label, does not redirect heading-target link. Full general Markdown parsing not claimed.
source_only_findings: apply_manifest has no original-byte digest or mtime binding from report to apply; approved paths are acted upon with current data. Concurrent/stale-manifest runtime not tested.

Both apply paths move extras after merge_content even when merge returnsFalse; thus limitations matter for canonical completeness, while trash retains source until overwritten/removed externally. No actual loss claimed.
Same-day trash destination names reused with src.rename, no explicit destination collision policy in code; platform overwrite behavior not exercised.
Canonical/redirect updates use direct write_text, unlike cleanup atomic temporary replacement; interruption recovery unqualified.
